definitions.gloss: to frighten; to scare; to intimidate
definitions.explanation: To cause someone to feel fear or anxiety. The causative form of 怖がる, meaning to make someone afraid.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}がらせないで。
⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}がらせた。
examples.english: I scared my friend with a dark story.

examples.japanese: ⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}がらせる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop deliberately scaring your little brother by making loud noises.

notes:
A causative form of {怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ (to be scared). While {怖|こわ}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧ describes someone feeling fear, {怖|こわ}がらせる means to cause that fear in another person. Often used when describing pranks, intimidation, or unintentional frightening.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}がらせる: to scare a child
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怖|こわ}がらせる: to frighten someone
- ⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧{怖|こわ}がらせる: to scare on purpose
- ⟦{脅|おど}して→脅す：27206_odosu⟧{怖|こわ}がらせる: to threaten and frighten

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脅|おど}かす: to startle or threaten — focuses on the sudden, shocking action rather than the resulting fear
- ⟦{怯|おび}えさせる→怯える：06037_obieru⟧: to terrify — stronger, implies deep or lasting fear
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}かす→驚かす：01918_odorokasu⟧: to surprise — neutral; not necessarily negative, can be a pleasant surprise
